problem: Legal authorization or ceiling does not prove issuance delivery or payment.
rule: Keep authorization in its own phase and never carry amounts forward automatically.
evidence: Decree 214 art. 7; Decree 905 arts. 28-29; Law 25.796 arts. 2-4

problem: Decree 905 defines entity-level balance formulas without a closed aggregate amount.
rule: Report the formula and leave the aggregate open until issuer/accounting evidence supplies it.

problem: Issued and placed debt is a liability stock rather than a cash disbursement.
rule: Label stock and instrument; do not call it paid cash.

problem: Original nominal amount and updated ARS/USD values are different measures.
rule: Preserve source currency date and valuation basis; never mix columns.

problem: End-year stocks combine issuance amortization redemption valuation and corrections.
rule: Do not infer annual flows from stock deltas without a transaction bridge.

problem: Treasury issuer stock and BCRA-reported bank holdings/receivables cover different universes.
rule: Keep ONP/CGN issuer tables separate from BCRA beneficiary balance-sheet stocks.
evidence: ONP 2003Q4 cuadro 37; BCRA BEF table IV.1

problem: Compensaciones a recibir are recognized claims rather than delivered assets.
rule: Classify as receivable and not as payment.

problem: CGN transfers-granted rows are compatibility/reconciliation entries between budget and accounting records.
rule: Use as accounting recognition and not as proof of cash movement.

problem: Broad BODEN totals include compensation coverage depositors quasi-currency redemption and 13-percent restitution.
rule: Use the official purpose buckets and never label total BODEN as bank aid.

problem: Coverage can involve exchange or subscription and potential BCRA financing after applying peso bonds.
rule: Separate compensation exchange subscription and BCRA advance legs.

problem: BCRA advances and BCRA obligations to the Treasury are financing balances.
rule: Keep them out of Treasury compensation flows.

problem: Sixty-installment loss deferral smooths accounting recognition.
rule: Exclude from fiscal transfer amounts.

problem: The definitive compensation amount and assets remained pending at end-2003.
rule: Do not publish a final through-2003 realized total.

problem: Named 2003 accounting entries may overlap pre-existing instrument stocks.
rule: Do not add Galicia/Citibank notes to ONP stocks without instrument identifiers and dates.

problem: A compensation asset can coexist with losses funding costs duration mismatch and FX mismatch.
rule: Do not equate gross compensation with bank profit or final household-to-bank incidence.
evidence: BCRA Congress 2002 pp.28-36; BCRA BEF pp.8-49

problem: hist_bcra_baldethis.xls contains risk/result tables but no detailed fiscal compensation ledger.
rule: Record the negative audit and do not fabricate a fiscal series from unrelated balance rows.

problem: A later budget law can validate an earlier extra-budgetary registration.
rule: Attribute the amount to its original accounting period and keep the later act non-additive.

problem: Qualitative administrative finalization can precede later issues and corrections.
rule: Do not treat narrative closure language as a transactional endpoint.
evidence: CGN 2004 SDP p.71; CGN 2005-2006 SDP Anexo J

problem: Net issuance after prior-placement adjustments can be negative.
rule: Preserve the sign and do not replace with zero or call it amortization.
evidence: CGN 2005 SDP p.87; CGN 2006 SDP p.132

problem: A devengado transfer is not proof of cash settlement by beneficiary and date.
rule: Label budget accrual and require payment records for cash.
evidence: CGN 2005 tomo I p.118; CGN 2006 tomo I p.142

problem: Budget headings combine banks and depositors.
rule: Use bank-specific rows when available; keep the mixed bucket as control only.

problem: The 2006 assistance bucket includes BNA capitalization.
rule: Subtract nothing mechanically; retain the whole bucket as non-additive and use identified components separately.

problem: BODEN 2007 and 2012 service aggregates holders from multiple purposes.
rule: Do not allocate series amortization to banks without holder-purpose records.

problem: Coverage bonds are subscribed and can involve a price payment and financing.
rule: Separate VNO issue subscription paid and price-difference transfer.

problem: Financial-entity deposits under Decree 905 run from banks to the Treasury.
rule: Keep the counterflow out of gross Treasury-to-bank compensation.
evidence: CGN 2005 tomo I p.124; CGN 2006 tomo I p.136

problem: A financing-source placement line differs from a current-transfer accrual.
rule: Never sum placement financing with transfer execution absent accounting keys.

problem: Law 25.796 ceiling and later net issues are different phases.
rule: Report authorized ceiling separately from 2005-2006 issuance.

problem: Two AGN reports narrow the aggregate-holder and FGS-control sides, but no mechanism-specific delivery audit was located.
rule: Use the AGN controls only at their published scope; keep CRYL/entity reconciliation open.

problem: Annual principal and interest are reported for the whole BODEN series.
rule: Do not allocate series service to compensation banks without holder-purpose records.
evidence: CGN SDP 2007-2012 detailed debt movement tables

problem: Modified opening balances can differ from the prior published closing balance.
rule: Preserve the opening adjustment explicitly before testing the annual flow equation.
evidence: CGN SDP 2007-2010 detailed debt movement tables

problem: Original-unit principal movement and ARS accounting service columns are distinct measures.
rule: Keep both columns and never sum them as if homogeneous.
evidence: CGN SDP 2007-2012 detailed debt movement tables

problem: Buyback totals mix BODEN with other securities and GDP units.
rule: Treat tender totals as non-additive controls until instrument-level awards are recovered.

problem: A program phrase may be absent from Anexo J while series service appears in the debt table.
rule: Record only a scoped absence; do not infer zero activity.

problem: A zero closing stock proves series maturity, not who received service.
rule: Keep holder and purpose allocation open after maturity.

problem: AGN creditor shares cover total public debt rather than BODEN 2012.
rule: Use them as aggregate context only and do not equate private sector with banks.

problem: A duplicated FGS inventory presentation changes reported holdings without a Treasury flow.
rule: Record the exception as a public-holder control correction, non-additive to issuance and service.

problem: AGN transparency confirms reports were identified for consultation but does not itself expose a holder register.
rule: Use the route to continue resolution/actuación retrieval; do not treat it as delivery evidence.

problem: A tender offer is not an award.
rule: Keep received offers separate; a deserted tender realizes zero.

problem: Published tender participant may act for own account or submit for other investors.
rule: Report the named participant and keep ultimate holder/beneficiary unidentified unless custody or order-level evidence closes it.

problem: An award precedes delivery confirmation and BCRA-account payment.
rule: Require Caja de Valores and BCRA confirmations before marking cash-settled.

problem: Participant awards are not printed as a separate table.
rule: Derive only when accepted offers under the rule reproduce both published VNO and effective totals exactly.

problem: Effective USD and effective ARS use tender-specific reference FX.
rule: Preserve the published FX per tender and do not reuse it across dates.

problem: Budget expansion to register placements does not prove delivery or payment.
rule: Keep the DNU as a qualitative residual-program control until annex/execution records are found.

problem: A separately tradable coupon strip is not the full BODEN 2012 stock.
rule: Track the 2009 strip authorization separately from full-bond awards and service.

problem: A program aggregate spanning several securities cannot be assigned to BODEN 2012.
rule: Keep mixed first-stage amounts outside instrument subtotals until a trade blotter exists.

problem: CGN buyback execution lacks species, channel and counterparties.
rule: Use it as a non-additive ceiling/control and never add it to tender totals.

problem: An instruction to BNA does not identify executed trades.
rule: Require date, instrument, quantity, price and counterparty before allocating first-stage purchases.

problem: A contemporary secondary tender summary does not replace the primary result or settlement confirmation.
rule: Label every quantitative strip value secondary and keep amount basis and payment open.

problem: Broad debt creditor sectors do not identify holders of a specific instrument.
rule: Do not convert private-sector share into bank share or BODEN ownership.

problem: First-stage, public-tender and budget-execution aggregates may overlap.
rule: Never add them without an accounting bridge that proves disjoint scope.

problem: A same-day result communiqué says a purchase was made but also schedules later settlement.
rule: Keep the event at award/result status until post-settlement Caja/BCRA evidence is preserved.

problem: Cada llamado fija un monto máximo hasta el cual comprar, no un compromiso ni desembolso.
rule: Usar el techo sólo como denominador descriptivo; nunca sumarlo a adjudicaciones o ejecución.

problem: El archivo oficial enumera piezas publicadas, pero no certifica entrega Caja ni pago BCRA.
rule: Cerrar la serie publicada y mantener abierta la liquidación y cualquier pieza no archivada.

problem: Identificar la cuenta Caja 0306/40000 no prueba que los títulos hayan ingresado.
rule: Exigir confirmación Caja T+3 y asiento/pago BCRA antes de marcar cash-settled.

problem: El valor efectivo del cupón y el VNO del BODEN subyacente son bases distintas.
rule: Conservar ambas columnas y no sumarlas ni sustituir una por otra.

problem: Una captura archivada puede preservar el binario oficial aunque la URL institucional histórica deje de resolver.
rule: Registrar URL original, sello de captura, digest CDX y hash local; no degradar el documento a fuente secundaria.

problem: Dos montos cercanos y conversiones por fecha no forman una conciliación contable exacta.
rule: Usar la brecha sólo como control de orden de magnitud y mantener CONTROL_NOT_ADDITIVE.

problem: El nodo público reproduce metadatos y un resumen, no la respuesta individual ni sus adjuntos.
rule: Usar el API para fijar esquema y omisiones públicas; requerir el expediente para conocer la respuesta enviada.

problem: Que Caja/CNV no entreguen datos a AGN no implica tenencias cero ni inexistencia de registros.
rule: Clasificar como barrera de acceso y mantener abiertos padrón y liquidación.

problem: La auditoría cubre 2009-2013 y una nota de 2014, no las liquidaciones de 2008.
rule: Usarla como control institucional de divulgación, no como prueba directa de cada operación.

problem: La diferencia DISP-DMO es para deuda intrasector agregada y vintages 2009-2014.
rule: Conservarla como control de fuente; no asignarla a BODEN, recompras, bancos o beneficiarios.

problem: Una actuación de 2008-2009 es anterior a GDE y puede tener sólo identificador COMDOC; papel o sistema heredado.
rule: Buscar primero el identificador original y luego toda migración; digitalización o cruce a GDE/GEDO/RUDO.
evidence: Consulta de expedientes del Ministerio de Economía; convenio GDE BNA 2022

problem: Que una norma permita reproducir un documento después de cierto plazo no acredita que el original haya sido destruido.
rule: Pedir copia autenticada; soporte; actas y registro de reproducción; y acto concreto de destrucción si se invoca.
evidence: Texto ordenado BCRA sobre conservación y reproducción

problem: El vencimiento de un plazo mínimo de conservación no demuestra que un registro haya sido eliminado.
rule: Exigir serie; regla históricamente aplicable y acto o inventario individualizable de disposición.
evidence: Normas BCRA/CNV; Directriz AGN de Evaluación Documental

problem: Una regla de retención publicada hoy no necesariamente regía ni se aplica retroactivamente a documentación de 2008.
rule: Pedir la regla vigente para la serie y período objetivos; además de migraciones y disposiciones posteriores.
evidence: CNV Título VIII artículo 65; Comisión de Evaluación Documental

problem: Un archivo histórico público con fondo BCRA hasta 1991 no cubre registros operativos CRyL de 2008-2009.
rule: Usar el alcance publicado como control negativo y exigir búsqueda en sistemas y archivos operativos internos.
evidence: Estado de fondos del Archivo de Documentos Históricos BCRA

problem: Una norma archivística derogada no crea una obligación procedimental vigente aunque describa prácticas históricas.
rule: Verificar vigencia artículo por artículo y fundar el pedido en la regla actual o en la traza concreta del documento.

problem: Un procedimiento contemporáneo BOCON prueba áreas; sistemas y clases documentales disponibles, pero no que las recompras usaran esa misma ruta.
rule: Usar TSA; COMDOC III; SIGADE y constancias como hipótesis de búsqueda y exigir confirmación de aplicabilidad.

problem: Un diseño de archivo o formulario CRyL prueba campos y clases de registro, no que exista un registro para la operación objetivo.
rule: Buscar CG1-CG7 y formularios 4359 por fecha; cuenta y especie; mantener liquidación abierta hasta obtener el asiento.

problem: Una cadena normativa aplicable puede conservar varias modalidades simultáneas sin identificar cuál se usó en una operación.
rule: Reconstruir vigencia y luego exigir la instrucción; lote o asiento objetivo antes de asignar DVP; FTC; FT u otra modalidad.

problem: La validación satisfactoria de un archivo CGA sólo supera la primera etapa y queda condicionada a futura liquidación.
rule: Exigir segunda etapa; CG3; débito/crédito o conciliación; nunca clasificar el acuse CGA como pago.

problem: Que CG1-CG7 y CGA sigan enumerados en 2012 no demuestra que los lotes de 2008-2009 hayan sido conservados o migrados.
rule: Pedir repositorio; tabla de equivalencias; política de retención y búsqueda por lote/fecha; admitir respuesta negativa sólo si es reproducible.

problem: El procedimiento de recompra nombra Caja; cuenta BCRA y modalidad diferida pero omite siglas CRyL/DVP/FTC/TSA/SIGADE.
rule: Registrar el silencio como brecha de identificación; no inferir ausencia de uso del sistema ni modalidad concreta.

problem: La modalidad diferida describe el tipo o programación de transferencia; TSA describe un canal de archivos que puede transportarla.
rule: Mantener canal y modalidad en campos separados y exigir el registro objetivo antes de asignarlos a 2008.

problem: Los formularios F-33914.01 y F-33915.01 documentan un esquema de transferencia diferida en 2017, no su edición o uso en 2008.
rule: Usarlos sólo como diccionario retrospectivo de campos y pedir la versión vigente o la tabla de equivalencias histórica.

problem: La existencia de fecha de ejecución, límite de matching y contrapartes en un formulario vacío no prueba una instrucción emparejada ni ejecutada.
rule: Exigir formulario completado, lote, estado de matching y asiento de recepción para cada fecha y especie.

problem: El Nuevo Sistema de Custodia eliminó en 2023 los tipos diferida e inmediata; esa regla nueva no describe automáticamente 2008.
rule: Usar el cambio como corte metodológico y no retrotraerlo al período objetivo.

problem: ISIN, código de negociación y código de custodia/CVSA son identificadores diferentes aunque señalen la misma especie.
rule: Conservar cada columna y documentar el puente fuente por fuente; no reemplazar un identificador por otro.

problem: El código del BODEN 2012 principal no identifica necesariamente la subespecie separada cupón 15 de 2009.
rule: Usar 5326 para ARARGE03G415 y conservar 5426 sólo para el BODEN 2012 principal; no colapsar ambas especies.
evidence: Llamado strip 2009; Banco Columbia Anexo A; Banco Patagonia Exhibit A

problem: Una tabla bancaria contemporánea puede identificar inequívocamente la especie sin documentar la entrega, recepción o liquidación de la recompra objetivo.
rule: Aceptar la tabla para el puente de identificadores y mantener abiertos los asientos de Caja, el matching y el pago BCRA.

problem: La CNV prueba formularios numerados de Recepción Diferida en agosto de 2009, pero no identifica la revisión vigente durante las rondas de 2008.
rule: Usar 2009 como práctica cercana y solicitar la revisión, vigencia o tabla de equivalencias exacta de 2008.

problem: La página legal fecha la edición del manual SLIQ en marzo de 2000, pero una fecha de impresión no acredita continuidad sin cambios hasta 2008.
rule: Aceptar marzo de 2000 como fecha interna de la edición y mantener abierta la revisión efectiva en cada ronda de 2008.
evidence: Manual Sistema de Transferencias Electrónicas, página PDF 2

problem: La página institucional archivada en 2004 confirma la disponibilidad del Sistema de Transferencias Electrónicas y su documentación, pero no identifica la revisión aplicable en 2008.
rule: Usarla para disponibilidad preobjetivo; exigir el control de cambios o registro maestro SLIQ/SCG para cerrar vigencia.
evidence: Merval, Documentación de Sistemas Informáticos, captura 2004-02-08

problem: El manual MU-32002.03 conserva revisiones 2006/2007/2009 y fecha de vigencia, pero corresponde a la cuenta CVSA-DTC y no al sistema local SLIQ.
rule: Usar su tabla como esquema de control documental exigible y no trasladar números, fechas ni vigencia al manual objetivo.

problem: La memoria de Caja muestra infraestructura y actividad/ingresos por transferencias antes de 2008 sin desagregar modalidad, cuenta, especie ni estado.
rule: Tratarla sólo como contexto operativo preobjetivo y exigir instrucción, matching, asiento e informe T+3 para las rondas.
evidence: Caja, Memoria y Estados Contables 2006, páginas PDF 20 y 44-45

problem: Una comunicación contemporánea de Caja que ordena cuenta, modalidad, matching, plazo y cantidad total prueba el circuito instruido, no que la transferencia haya sido ejecutada.
rule: Exigir instrucción individual, estado de matching, asiento y lote ejecutado para afirmar entrega o recepción.

problem: Las comunicaciones preservadas cubren tres de las cuatro rondas de 2008; que una consulta del archivo no devuelva la cuarta no prueba inexistencia ni falta de ejecución.
rule: Declarar cobertura parcial y mantener abierta la comunicación equivalente de la licitación del 02/10/2008.
evidence: Caja Comunicados 4857, 4861 y 4873; archivo institucional consultado para octubre de 2008

problem: La fórmula 'Caja suministrará' fija fecha y contenido del informe T+3, pero no demuestra que el informe haya sido producido, entregado o recibido.
rule: Exigir el informe T+3, su constancia de transmisión o una certificación institucional por ronda.

problem: El código de pie OYM F.89023.00 identifica el formato de las comunicaciones, pero no acredita por sí solo la revisión del manual SLIQ/SCG vigente.
rule: Conservarlo como clave documental y pedir por separado el registro maestro o control de cambios SLIQ/SCG.
evidence: Pie común de Caja Comunicados 4857, 4861, 4873 y 5152

problem: Una consulta exhaustiva de la vista pública actual no cubre correspondencia interna, anexos, expedientes o registros retirados.
rule: Formular sólo 'no figura en el archivo público actual' y mantener la búsqueda institucional de la cuarta comunicación.
evidence: Caja CA133_01/02; V138 public settlement exhaustion

problem: Una reducción contable agregada exacta no identifica cada transferencia, matching, asiento de Caja o pago BCRA.
rule: Elevar la realización sólo a baja contable agregada y mantener abiertos los registros por ronda/oferta.

problem: El VNO original adjudicado de bonos amortizantes no es directamente comparable con el principal residual que reduce el stock.
rule: Aplicar factores residuales 0,5 BODEN 2012 y 0,625 BODEN 2013 antes de conciliar.
evidence: Resultados oficiales; Deuda Pública 2008Q3; exact identity 8.596,5+8.217,5=16.814 miles USD

problem: La nota que excluye GDP Units del cuadro no informa un valor cero ni revierte las adjudicaciones publicadas.
rule: Conservar la exclusión como reconocimiento de alcance y exigir el registro específico de las unidades.
evidence: Prospectus S-25; Deuda Q4 A.5.1 B63/A.5.4 B62; report p.2

problem: El agregado Q4 de Bonos del Canje no trae especie, fecha, precio ni expediente que lo vincule con una modalidad concreta.
rule: No asignarlo a primera etapa, cuatro rondas ni tenedores sin detalle de operaciones.
evidence: Deuda Q3/Q4 A.12.2; informe Decreto 1735/04 p.2; SIGADE Q3; bridge V138

problem: La conciliación cruzada asigna la baja Q4 al Discount en Pesos agregado, pero no expone operaciones individuales.
rule: Permitir la identificación de especie y tramo de referencia 2006; mantener abiertos fecha, vendedor, matching Caja y riel de pago.

problem: VNO ARS 2.748,50m, valor efectivo ARS 1.415,50m y baja actualizada ARS 4.723,53619m son bases distintas.
rule: No sumarlas ni intercambiarlas: VNO mide nominal adquirido, valor efectivo la consideración agregada reportada y la baja contable el stock actualizado eliminado.
evidence: Informe Decreto 1735/04 p.2; Deuda Q3/Q4 A.12.2 y A.5.1

problem: Las GDP Units usan monto nocional y no tienen pagos de principal.
rule: No exigir una fila de stock principal como condición de existencia; buscar recompra, cancelación y pagos contingentes por separado.
evidence: Prospectus Supplement S-25; Deuda Q4 A.5.1 B63/A.5.4 B62

problem: El año de referencia 2006 no es la fecha de compra.
rule: Aplicar la regla contractual: cálculo 2007-11-01 y ventana calendario 2008; mantener el día individual abierto.

problem: El tercer cupón anunciado en 2008 corresponde al año de referencia 2007 y expresa importes por unidad.
rule: No usar esos importes como precio, efectivo agregado ni constancia de cancelación de la recompra referencia 2006.
evidence: Comunicado tercer cupón 2008 p.1; Prospectus Supplement

problem: La Resolución 115/323 regula excedente de capacidad de pago anual, mecanismo distinto del cinco por ciento de Excess GDP.
rule: Usar su secuencia sólo como esquema de productores/campos; exigir documento específico antes de atribuir MAE, Caja T+3 o cuentas BCRA al evento objetivo.
evidence: Resolución Conjunta 115/2005 y 323/2005; Prospectus Supplement S-19/S-69

problem: Official acquired totals are printed to 0.01 million while tender awards are available to currency units/cents.
rule: Carry a ±0.005m band per printed component; report shares to two decimals and never present the residual as exact to cents.
evidence: retrospective report p2; four official result PDFs

problem: Award plus annual accounting attribution does not prove scheduled securities transfer, Treasury debit or CRyL cancellation.
rule: Classify as awarded and imputed; keep Caja/BCRA/CRyL settlement states open.

problem: Official total minus recovered public awards is a remainder across transactions/channels, not a blotter.
rule: Call it other-channel arithmetic residual unless an operation-level record allocates it to direct purchases.

problem: Award shares by intermediary can concentrate even when underlying holders are dispersed.
rule: Label HHI and CR values descriptive participant metrics only; prohibit market-power and beneficiary-concentration inference.
evidence: participant distribution V138; normative intermediary rule

problem: A contemporaneous BCRA account number identifies a possible rail, not an executed Treasury payment.
rule: Require payment order plus BCRA debit/credit record reconciled to Caja T+3 confirmation.

problem: B9195 was superseded before the August-October 2008 tenders.
rule: Use B9322, updated to 04/08/2008, for target-date mapping; retain B9195 only as version control.

problem: The final report/Act.41/Res.202 identity is now exact, while the internal code 48 0237/09 remains absent from final metadata.
rule: Close final identity; describe project lineage as strong contextual bridge until an internal equivalence table is produced.
evidence: AGN API UUID; Res.202/2009; Q2 tracker; report self-description

problem: AGN publishes all-debt increases and decreases, with an internal USD769m literal arithmetic tension, but no target transaction register.
rule: Keep the figures aggregate, freeze the discrepancy and never allocate decreases to buybacks or banks without workpapers.

problem: CGN lists annual Caja service fees and bank commissions without operation, ISIN, date or expediente allocation.
rule: Use SIGADE/SIDIF as search keys only; require subledger reconciliation before attributing any amount to the buyback program.
evidence: CGN Cuenta de Inversión 2008 Anexo K p67

problem: Exact final metadata does not print 48 0237/09.
rule: Do not collapse final identity and internal project-code identity into one claim.

problem: Q3/Q4 resolutions prove reports and magnetic annexes but public nodes expose only resolutions.
rule: Treat annex existence as exact and annex contents/progress as open.

problem: The DADP manual formalized in 2015 and audit period 2016-2018 identify record classes after the target events.
rule: Use them to target records, never as retroactive proof of 2008 execution or retention.

problem: Other years publish individual SIDIF/C-41 IDs for the same account families.
rule: Use comparators to demonstrate feasible format, not to allocate 2008 annual fees.

problem: The norm cites S01:0342455/2008 and custodians but the body is not public.
rule: Separate existence/identity of the file from recovery of its contents and from execution.

problem: Senate detail pages prove transmission and archive routing but do not expose Texto original.
rule: Use OV identifiers as custody locators; keep annex content and project progress open.

problem: The official COMDOC endpoint refused connection.
rule: Record the query as unexecuted and escalate by exact legacy identifier; never code the result as no record.

problem: The 2009 Anexo K leaves SIDIF cells blank while adjacent years aggregate or itemize the same keys.
rule: Treat blank, VARIOS and itemized as publication states; require subledger before any transaction inference.

problem: FindDoc's public output is proven for route and location fields.
rule: Use it to trace custody; request the body separately.

problem: AGN queried another S01/2008 successfully in 2013.
rule: Use as operational control only; keep S01:0342455/2008 unqueried.

problem: C-41 is an order that can require processing, TGN action, debit and adjustment.
rule: Require payment/debit status and C-55 or equivalent where applicable.

problem: A large HCDN archive batch is temporally adjacent but does not list the two exact target strings.
rule: Retain exact Senate metadata as locator and request the 18/05/2012 note.
evidence: HCDN reunión 8; Senate OV 366/09 and OV 44/10

problem: Search snippets can shift identifiers between horizontally aligned table rows.
rule: The rendered visual row controls account, amount and SIDIF attribution.
evidence: CGN Cuenta de Inversión 2008 Anexo K, physical PDF page 67

problem: SDPGB/SDPAG define paid, rejected and annulled outputs.
rule: Require the target row or certified successor extract before assigning a state.

problem: The exact SDPGB/SDPAG filenames are proved in 1997.
rule: Request the named files or their 2008 successor equivalent; do not assert unchanged format.

problem: TGN/BCRA instruction, movement and balance file classes are documented for 2008.
rule: Require identifiers and target linkage for each of the three C-41 orders.
evidence: Cuenta de Inversión 2008 Tomo II, printed p.177

problem: The 2008 external-payment rule provides detailed fields for SAF 355/356.
rule: Apply only after an order is classified as an external payment.

problem: COMDOC custody and another debt-title procedure expose useful document classes.
rule: Use as search comparators, never as proof that the target was governed by or generated the same records.

problem: Circular 07/08 replaces only the Entes module.
rule: Do not treat it as deployment of e-SIDIF Gastos or payment processing.

problem: The 2008-2011 sequence proves a legacy environment and later Gastos rollout.
rule: Classify SDPGB/SDPAG continuity as highly supported but request the 2008 name or functional successor.

problem: A conforming order may receive partial payments before expiry.
rule: Require original amount, each payment, cumulative paid and residual balance.

problem: AGAN/AMIDDF is competent for financial supporting documents.
rule: Do not claim target custody until an index result, image, signatura or certified response is obtained.

problem: The 2009 disposition specifies paper and daily signed records.
rule: Use it as an immediate successor/comparator unless direct 2008 applicability is proved.

problem: The 2009 account describes receipt of CRYL movements as an incorporation.
rule: Keep general BCRA movement files in 2008 separate from CRYL-specific movement receipt.

problem: AMIDDF competence and schema do not prove a target remittance.
rule: Require the completed remittance/index row and box before asserting custody.

problem: The 1998 SAF/control/judicial query procedure is not the current citizen route.
rule: Use Law 27.275 through the Ministry RAIP and keep the historic rule only for custody mechanics.

problem: Anexo K labels the column SIDIF, not C-41.
rule: Call 71597, 152677 and 2876 SIDIF locators until the type field is recovered.

problem: C-43 form and file-flow sources are adjacent but different.
rule: Never use C-43 fields or filenames to establish C-41 behavior.

problem: Paper rules vary by source, amount, payer and date.
rule: Request the paper trail but mark target applicability open until form/payer/source or remittance is returned.
